svg.title: Josh Perry
svg.desc: Josh Perry. Software engineer, Bangkok. Now: software engineer at Balerion. Side quest: an e-commerce tool that shows shops their real profit. Off the clock: writing music. Always: build with purpose. Usually built with Go, TypeScript, React, Next.js, TanStack, PostgreSQL, Redis, GCP, Docker.

g.text: Side quest — an e-commerce tool that shows shops their real profit
